newsitem.title: FRANCE: Forest fire destroys 700 hectares in southern France.
newsitem.headline: Forest fire destroys 700 hectares in southern France.

text.p: A blaze has destroyed some 700 hectares of pine forest in the Landes region south of Bordeaux, fire officials said on Wednesday.
It began late on Tuesday afternoon and burned until the early hours, but no injuries or damage to property were reported.
No cause of the fire was immediately known.
Several weeks of dry and unseasonably warm weather in France have raised fears of a drought.
